title: Scenery adds LLM scripting for spatial scenes
excerpt: With scripting support inside @Scenery you can expose your entire spatial scene to an LLM as a function
analysis: The hook is not labeled yet. Watch the first five seconds before using this as a pattern. Reported 6,600 views and 105 likes on the gallery listing, a like rate of 1.59 percent, above the library median of 0.56 percent. At 74 seconds it compares best with the 60 second structure.
